1080x1080.notes: Square. The one shape that runs everywhere on Meta -- feed post, feed ad, and the safe fallback in a carousel.
1080x1080._textCoverageSource: Meta's 20% text guideline. It stopped being a rejection rule in September 2020 and is now a delivery signal: a text-heavy image is served less, not refused. Checked 2026-08-28.
1080x1080._verifiedAgainst: Meta's published maximum for an image asset across Facebook and Instagram placements: 30 MB, JPG or PNG. Confirmed 2026-08-30. Recorded as the rule and its date rather than as a fetch: facebook.com is not reachable from this build environment. This is a ceiling a rendered banner cannot approach, so it exists to say the limit was checked, not to constrain anything the renderer produces.
